_how_to_use: 406 JPEGs carved from a 119-page PDF of GCR trade reviews.
The PDF has almost no text layer (137 chars), so the content IS the images.
Tweet screenshots here are NOT all present in gcr_archive.txt - spot-checked
'fade listing pumps' (IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS) appears only in the images.
Review is incremental: set reviewed=true and fill notes as images are read.
'kind' is aspect-ratio guesswork; 'content' on a reviewed image is the truth (img001 is a header painting the ratio called a tweet).

Blotters are the highest-value images and CANNOT be found by pixel heuristics: they run 1 row to 9, light (Binance) and dark (FTX). A filter tuned on three light blotters missed img335 entirely. Use scripts/contact_sheets.py and look.

All 406 images have been TRIAGED via contact sheets; the ones with notes were then read at full resolution. Unreviewed entries are charts and repeats that the sheets showed carried nothing new - open them if you want, but the blotters, order tables and leads are all captured.
